top_candidates.subject: [clang][CodeGen] Omit pre-opt link when post-opt is link requested (#85672)
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This change moves linking of supplied builtin bitcode modules from before optimization to a post-optimization link path when CodeGenOpts.LinkBitcodePostopt is enabled. It skips normal frontend linking in that mode, removes reloading of link modules before the post-opt link, makes LinkInModulesPass report that analyses are invalidated after linking, and replaces an experimental relink flag with the CodeGenOpts.LinkBitcodePostopt option.
Changed symbols: LinkInModulesPass::run; BackendConsumer::ReloadModules; BackendConsumer::HandleTranslationUnit; CodeGenAction::ExecuteAction; EmitAssemblyHelper::RunOptimizationPipeline; BackendConsumer::LinkInModules; ClRelinkBuiltinBitcodePostop
Behavioral change: Skips pre-optimization LinkInModules calls when CodeGenOpts.LinkBitcodePostopt is enabled.; Links supplied builtin bitcode via the post-optimization LinkInModulesPass instead of relying on the removed relink option.; Removes bitcode module reloading in LinkInModulesPass.; Returns PreservedAnalyses::none() after post-opt module linking, correctly invalidating module analyses after mutation.
Reproducer link: The issue description provides an -O1 asm-goto pointer-loop testcase but does not state that it uses -mlink-builtin-bitcode or post-optimization bitcode linking.; No retrieved hunk references asm goto, asm-goto outputs, pointer loops, or loop-exit value rewriting.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen; post-optimization module linking; LLVM module-pass analysis preservation
Causal explanation: Post-opt linking can change which IR is available to, or follows, optimization and the commit explicitly changes analysis invalidation after module mutation. That is optimizer-adjacent, but it is conditional on LinkBitcodePostopt and supplied builtin bitcode. The available issue context does not show either condition, and the patch does not touch ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, loop canonicalization, or asm-goto lowering, making a causal link to the reported crash unsupported by the retrieved evidence.
Causal confidence: 0.06
Build risk: Changing pre-opt versus post-opt module linking changes pipeline ordering and the set of IR seen by optimization passes.; Returning PreservedAnalyses::none() after linking is analysis-correctness-sensitive and may expose pipeline integration problems.; Only 3 hunks were omitted, but no test hunk was retrieved for the post-opt-linking behavior.

top_candidates.subject: [CodeGen] Move CodeGenPGO behind unique_ptr (NFC) (#142155)
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: Refactors CodeGenFunction ownership of CodeGenPGO from an embedded object to a std::unique_ptr, initializes it with std::make_unique in the CodeGenFunction constructor, and converts shown PGO accesses to pointer dereferences. Several profiling and MCDC helper definitions are moved or emitted out of line while retaining delegation to the same CodeGenPGO operations.
Changed symbols: CodeGenFunction::CodeGenFunction; CodeGenFunction::EmitCall; CodeGenFunction::GenerateCode; CodeGenFunction::GenerateBlockFunction; CodeGenFunction::GenerateObjCMethod; CodeGenFunction::AddInitializerToStaticVarDecl; CodeGenFunction::incrementProfileCounter; CodeGenFunction::getIsCounterPair
Behavioral change: CodeGenFunction now owns CodeGenPGO indirectly through a unique_ptr initialized during construction.; Shown profiling, coverage, counter-assignment, and indirect-call value-profiling operations retain the same delegated CodeGenPGO calls, but use PGO-> rather than PGO.; The commit is explicitly labeled NFC, and the retrieved changes do not show a change to generated control-flow semantics, asm-goto lowering, or optimizer pipeline behavior.
Pass or subsystem link: Clang CodeGen profiling and coverage support; not LLVM ScalarEvolution; not SCEVExpander; not rewriteLoopExitValues
Causal explanation: Although the change is in Clang CodeGen, its visible scope is CodeGenPGO ownership and profiling/MCDC delegation. The constructor context shows PGO is created before the shown uses, and the call-site conversions preserve the existing CodeGenPGO operation names. No retrieved hunk handles asm goto outputs, loop CFG formation, pointer induction variables, ScalarEvolution, SCEVExpander, or loop-exit rewriting. Consequently, there is no evidence-backed connection to the reported optimizer crash.

Summary: This revert changes Clang C++ cleanup and control-flow emission back to an earlier cleanup-stack model. It replaces `CleanupDeactivationScope`/deferred-deactivation use in array initialization and lambda aggregate emission with explicit cleanup iterators and dominator instructions, changes `EmitCallArg` to create an unreachable instruction rather than a flag load for `IsActive`, restores EH-only lifetime-extended destruction handling, and removes special insertion-point clearing while deactivating normal cleanups.

+  // Check conditions due to any @llvm.experimental.guard intrinsics.

+      LoopDispositions(64), BlockDispositions(64) {
+  // To use guards for proving predicates, we need to scan every instruction in
+  // relevant basic blocks, and not just terminators.  Doing this is a waste of
+  // time if the IR does not actually contain any calls to
+  // @llvm.experimental.guard, so do a quick check and remember this beforehand.
+  //
+  // This pessimizes the case where a pass that preserves ScalarEvolution wants
+  // to _add_ guards to the module when there weren't any before, and wants
+  // ScalarEvolution to optimize based on those guards.  For now we prefer to be

selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This changes Clang asm-goto code generation so outputs from a callbr are materialized not only on the fallthrough path but also on every indirect destination. For asm goto statements with outputs, EmitAsmStmt creates a synthetic split block for each indirect destination, redirects the callbr destination to that block, extracts or reuses the callbr result there, emits the output stores, and branches to the original destination.

Summary: This changes Clang asm-goto code generation so outputs from a callbr are materialized not only on the fallthrough path but also on every indirect destination. For asm goto statements with outputs, EmitAsmStmt creates a synthetic split block for each indirect destination, redirects the callbr destination to that block, extracts or reuses the callbr result there, emits the output stores, and branches to the original destination.
Changed symbols: CodeGenFunction::EmitAsmStmt

top_candidates.subject: [Dominators] check indirect branches of callbr
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit removes partial `CallBrInst` handling from `InstCombinerImpl::transformConstExprCastCall` and explicitly declares callbr unsupported by that transformation. It stops recreating a callbr during constant-expression cast-call rewriting, removes the special treatment that selected only its default destination as a PHI-unsupported block, and adds an assertion that the transform must not receive a callbr because callbr has no single insertion point after its definition.
Changed symbols: InstCombinerImpl::visitCallBase; InstCombinerImpl::transformConstExprCastCall; CallBrInst
Behavioral change: `transformConstExprCastCall` no longer reconstructs a `CallBrInst` with `Builder.CreateCallBr`.; The transform no longer treats only `CallBrInst::getDefaultDest()` as the PHI-unsupported destination.; A debug assertion enforces the invariant that callbr instructions must not enter this transformation, because their control flow lacks a single post-definition insertion location.
Assertion or trace link: Introduced assertion: `CallBr's don't have a single point after a def to insert at`.; No `SCEVExpander`, `isKnownSentinel`, or `rewriteLoopExitValues` symbol appears in the retrieved change.
Reproducer link: asm goto with outputs is relevant because LLVM represents asm-goto control flow with `callbr`, and the issue reproducer uses asm goto outputs.; The retrieved hunks do not show a pointer-loop transformation, ScalarEvolution query, or loop-exit-value rewrite.
Pass or subsystem link: InstCombine; LLVM IR `CallBrInst` / asm-goto control-flow handling
Causal explanation: This is materially related to the reproducer's asm-goto/callbr IR: it prevents an InstCombine cast-call rewrite from attempting to rebuild or place instructions around a multi-successor callbr incorrectly. Such a change could alter the IR and dominance/PHI structure subsequently seen by loop optimizers. However, the reported crash is specifically in ScalarEvolution/SCEVExpander loop-exit rewriting, and the retrieved hunks contain no direct SCEV or loop-exit logic; the link is therefore indirect rather than demonstrated.
Causal confidence: 0.42

Summary: This change adjusts SelectionDAG handling for callbr-related output values by exempting CallBrInst from the existing "unused value assigned virtual registers" assertion in SelectionDAGBuilder::CopyToExportRegsIfNeeded. Summary: This commit adds the scaffolding for a legacy `CallBrPrepare` codegen IR pass intended to prepare callbr output values for SelectionDAG code generation. The pass is registered and can be invoked explicitly, but its implementation only scans for `CallBrInst`, performs no mutation, preserves all analyses, returns false, and remains disabled in the normal instruction-selection preparation pipeline through commented-out `addPass` calls.
Changed symbols: CallBrPrepare; CallBrPrepare::getAnalysisUsage; CallBrPrepare::runOnFunction; llvm::createCallBrPass; llvm::initializeCodeGen; TargetPassConfig::addISelPrepare; CodeGenPassBuilder::addISelPrepare
Behavioral change: Adds and registers a legacy `callbrprepare` function pass plus its factory declaration and CodeGen initialization.; The pass currently detects callbr terminators but makes no IR changes, reports no change, and preserves all analyses.; The normal codegen pipeline does not run the pass because both legacy and pass-builder insertion lines are commented out.; Adds a manually invoked `-callbrprepare` AArch64 test containing callbr asm outputs and a PHI at an indirect target, but the checked output reflects no transformation.
Assertion or trace link: The new source comments explicitly discuss `callbr` output values, indirect targets, and asm-goto output synchronization.; No `SCEVExpander`, `isKnownSentinel`, `ScalarEvolution`, or `rewriteLoopExitValues` symbol is touched.
Reproducer link: The new test uses inline-asm `callbr` instructions with output constraints and merges their outputs through a PHI on an indirect destination, matching the asm-goto-output portion of the issue domain.; The test does not contain the reported pointer loop or exercise optimizer loop-exit rewriting.
Pass or subsystem link: CodeGen `CallBrPrepare` / SelectionDAG preparation; LLVM IR `CallBrInst` handling
Causal explanation: The intended subsystem is relevant to asm-goto outputs, and the comments identify the same fundamental difficulty of using callbr output SSA values on indirect edges. Nevertheless, this candidate cannot affect the reported normal `-O1` optimizer crash through the shown code: the pass performs no transformation and is not inserted into either displayed default pipeline. diff --git a/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp b/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp

--- /dev/null
+++ b/llvm/lib/CodeGen/CallBrPrepare.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+//===-- CallBrPrepare - Prepare callbr for code generation ----------------===//
+//
+// Part of the LLVM Project, under the Apache License v2.0 with LLVM Exceptions.
+// See https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt for license information.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
+//
+//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
+//
+// This pass lowers callbrs in LLVM IR in order to to assist SelectionDAG's
+// codegen.
+//
+// In particular, this pass assists in inserting register copies for the output
+// values of a callbr along the edges leading to the indirect target blocks.
+// Though the output SSA value is defined by the callbr instruction itself in
+// the IR representation, the value cannot be copied to the appropriate virtual
+// registers prior to jumping to an indirect label, since the jump occurs
+// within the user-provided assembly blob.
+//
+// Instead, those copies must occur separately at the beginning of each
+// indirect target. That requires that we create a separate SSA definition in
+// each of them (via llvm.callbr.landingpad), and may require splitting
+// critical edges so we have a location to place the intrinsic. Finally, we
+// remap users of the original callbr output SSA value to instead point to the
+// appropriate llvm.callbr.landingpad value.
+//
+// Ideally, this could be done inside SelectionDAG, or in the
+// MachineInstruction representation, without the use of an IR-level intrinsic.
+// But, within the current framework, it’s simpler to implement as an IR pass.
+// (If support for callbr in GlobalISel is implemented, it’s worth considering
+// whether this is still required.)
+//
+//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
+
+#include "llvm/CodeGen/Passes.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
+#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
+#include "llvm/InitializePasses.h"
+#include "llvm/Pass.h"
+
+using namespace llvm;
+
+#define DEBUG_TYPE "callbrprepare"
+
+namespace {
+
+class CallBrPrepare : public FunctionPass {
+public:
+  CallBrPrepare() : FunctionPass(ID) {}
+  static char ID;
+  void getAnalysisUsage(AnalysisUsage &AU) const override;
+  bool runOnFunction(Function &Fn) override;
+};
+
+} // end anonymous namespace
+
+char CallBrPrepare::ID = 0;
+INITIALIZE_PASS(CallBrPrepare, DEBUG_TYPE, "Prepare callbr", false, false)
+
+FunctionPass *llvm::createCallBrPass() { return new CallBrPrepare(); }
+
+void CallBrPrepare::getAnalysisUsage(AnalysisUsage &AU) const {
+  AU.setPreservesAll();
+}
+
+bool CallBrPrepare::runOnFunction(Function &Fn) {
+  for (BasicBlock &BB : Fn) {
+    auto *CBR = dyn_cast<CallBrInst>(BB.getTerminator());
